column5: SOURCE-LIMITED BY DESIGN, and now correct (report e8c4c459). The frame draws a small signed number under each probability (3320:21045 "-1%", 3320:21055 "+2%", 8652:105711 "+9.88%") at Mulish 12/16, coloured #FF574A negative and green positive. The app now renders it from relativeMove(), which returns null in every state that is not a measured move. priorProbability is three-state on purpose: undefined = never looked up, null = looked up and this market has no priced trade in the window, a value = a real trade to difference against. Only the third produces a number, and the caller OMITS the line otherwise. Printing 0% would assert "the probability has not moved", which is a different and unverified claim - and today it would be the claim on EVERY row, because the board has recorded no trades. The Breaking sort and the Breaking news column already say "nothing found" rather than 0% for the same reason, and this row now agrees with them instead of contradicting them. It populates itself on the first trade with no further change.
